display_name: The whole Consumer Guarantees Act 1993 (NZ) under one top-level goal — for a supply and a failure, does the Act give redress, and which remedies does the consumer have against the supplier and the manufacturer — and four goals: scope, goods and the supplier, goods and the manufacturer, services

others: the Act gives redress for the supply to … (cga-scope.l4)
the forums for a claim of (cga-scope.l4)
the remedies against the supplier for (cga-goods.l4)
the remedies against the manufacturer for (cga-goods.l4)
the remedies against the supplier for the service failure (cga-services.l4)

scope: Every provision of the Act as in the PCO's version as at 24 January 2026 (ss 1-56), from the text converted from the PCO XML. Inputs: whether each guarantee is engaged and has failed; the acquirer's purpose; whether a failure can be remedied and whether the supplier or manufacturer refused or failed to; the limbs of ss 20, 21, 36 and the causes in ss 17, 26, 33; s 42 notices; the fairness of a contracting-out clause. Carried as text: the provisions in NOTES.md §2.

not_reviewed.note: No domain expert has read this against the Act. An independent test pass was run on 2026-10-15 (tests-independent.l4, 153 assertions from expectations written before the encoding was read). It found 8 disagreements, all resolved in its favour (s 41(2) and manufacturers, duplicated remedies, cancellation without a contract, s 36(c), the goods-only repair limb, and two refusals); the encoder's tests that encoded the rejected readings were changed and marked. 153/153 now pass. The pipeline has not been run.

forks.F1: ss 18(2)-(3), 32(a)-(b): a remediable but substantial failure opens both sets of remedies.
forks.F2: s 5A(2): a delivery failure that is not substantial gives only damages.
forks.F3: s 27(2): consequential damages from a manufacturer are not barred before repair is required.
forks.F4: s 41(2): a charity's supply bars redress only against the charity.
forks.F5: s 36(c): where the s 29 guarantee is engaged, whichever guarantee failed.
forks.F6: s 32(a)(ii)(B): cancellation needs a contract with the supplier.

checks.result: 7 modules: 268 assertions satisfied, 0 failed, 0 errors (115 encoder, 153 independent)
